description: Highland Village Town Center is a thriving community shopping destination located at 2230-2250 FM 407 in Highland Village, Texas, serving the affluent northern Dallas-Fort Worth suburbs. Anchored by Painted Tree Marketplace and Planet Fitness, this 101,874 square foot open-air center offers a diverse mix of retail, dining, fitness, and service tenants that cater to the area's upscale demographic. The property benefits from exceptional visibility along Justin Road, capturing over 29,000 vehicles daily, while serving a prosperous trade area where average household incomes exceed $154,000 within three miles. The tenant roster includes popular destinations like Salerno's Italian Restaurant, Wingstop, Revs Golf Lounge, and specialty services such as Sharkey's Cuts for Kids, Nails2Tails Dog Grooming, and Dance Integrity. With its strategic location near Marcus High School and a daytime population of 82,000+ within three miles, Highland Village Town Center has established itself as a convenient neighborhood hub for shopping, dining, fitness, and family-oriented services in one of the Dallas-Fort Worth area's most desirable communities.
